verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API-based virtual card issuance (highnote-docs-4, -27), a test environment that mirrors production for sandbox-to-live flow (highnote-docs-11, -26), and card data embedding via SDK to avoid PCI exposure (highnote-docs-14, -33), plus agentic commerce framing emphasizing API-driven, no-manual-provisioning issuance (highnote-docs-17). However, no evidence explicitly confirms PAN/CVV/expiry returned synchronously in the same create-card API call, nor that account holder approval/underwriting can be bypassed without any sales/onboarding process. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that PAN/CVV/expiry are returned in the single issuance API response, and evidence of self-serve signup without a sales cycle for live card issuance.
